Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: Interactive PvP combat frames, LB cues, survival helpers, and target clarity.
Description: A local PvP HUD with fixed Self/S1-S5 combat frames, optional exact row targeting and mouseover, calibrated LB gauges, direct ally LB damage, pressure and CC cues, survival and job helpers, low-MP Focus, fail-closed assists, team communication, and target highlights.
Changelog: Adds optional exact Combat Frame targeting/mouseover, evidence-only LB gauges, activations, countdowns and direct ally LB damage, plus default-off DRK Hiebsprung and expanded BRD urgent counter-CC. Schema 27 keeps the Combat Frames master and action helpers opt-in; remote LB remains unknown until live native-HUD calibration.
